description: Get what creating an inventory item needs. Without arguments: the organization's category tree plus the required fields that apply to ALL items. With categoryId: that category's full field list (required and optional, with types and select options); the fieldDefIds are the keys of customFields in create_item and preview_item_create. A category is required for every item except a draft (isDraft: true). The server checks that a category exists, not that it fits the item: an item filed under an unfitting category shows there for everyone. create_category adds a new category.
